_note: First-contact messages (fixed wording, no AI involved). Pierce's standard (Nov 1 2026): the buyer gets the email with links 1-2 min after the inquiry, then a text 4-6 min later pointing them to it, with one qualifying question. Written as Pierce. No 'Reply STOP' line (replies to the buyer's own inquiry, not cold outreach; STOP/opt-out words are still honored in code). No AI announcement. Placeholders: {first} {who} {property} {platform} (' on Crexi' etc.) {availability} ('under contract' / 'sold') {details} (email links block) {sms_link} (CA link sentence for text-only leads).
sms_after_email: Hey{first}, this is {who}. Just sent you an email with the info on {property}, so check your inbox when you get a chance. Let me know if you need anything else. Are you buying on your own or with a group?
listing_email: Hey{first}, this is {who}. Saw your inquiry on {property}{platform}.{sms_link} What's the best email to send you the details? And are you buying on your own or with a group?
webhook: Hey{first}, this is {who}. Saw your inquiry on {property}{platform}.{sms_link} What's the best email to send you the details? And are you buying on your own or with a group?
default: Hey{first}, this is {who}. Thanks for your interest in {property}.{sms_link} What's the best email to send you the details? And are you buying on your own or with a group?
csv: Hey{first}, this is {who}. Following up on your interest in {property}. Still looking at parks right now?
sms_link: Here's the CA for the OM and financials: {ca_link}
favorite_after_email: Hey{first}, this is {who}. Saw you saved {property}{platform} and sent you an email with the details, so check your inbox when you get a chance. Are you buying on your own or with a group?
favorite: Hey{first}, this is {who}. Saw you saved {property}{platform}. Want me to send over the details? What's the best email?
sms_unavailable: Hey{first}, this is {who}. Thanks for your inquiry on {property}. That one is {availability}, but I have other listings I can share. What are you looking for?
email_first_touch:
Hi{first},

Thanks for your inquiry on {property}{platform}.{details}

A few quick questions so I can get you the right information: are you buying on your own or with a group, do you own parks today, and how are you planning to finance?

Let me know if you need anything else.

Thanks,
email_favorite:
Hi{first},

Saw you saved {property}{platform}, so I wanted to send over the details.{details}

A couple quick questions so I send the right information: are you buying on your own or with a group, and what size and location are you focused on?

Thanks,
email_unavailable:
Hi{first},

Thanks for reaching out about {property}. It's {availability} right now, but I have other listings I can share.

What are you looking for in terms of property type, size and location? I'll send over anything that fits.

Thanks,
email_details_ca: The CA is here, and once it's signed I'll send the OM, rent roll and financials: {ca_link}
